03 · Questions

Asked and
answered

Which HSK levels do these lists cover?

All six levels of the HSK syllabus, HSK 1 through HSK 6, each as its own list and its own pack in the app. HSK 1 is free in the app; every other level opens with a free preview and another word unlocks daily.

Where do the word lists come from?

Word list: the six-level HSK syllabus (HSK 2.0). Definitions adapted from CC-CEDICT, licensed CC BY-SA 4.0. Example sentences are original Lock&Learn content.

Is Lock&Learn Chinese free?

Yes. The app is free on iOS: HSK 1 is free, every other pack opens with a free preview, and another word unlocks daily. Lock&Learn+ is an optional upgrade that opens every pack at once, offered as a yearly plan or a one-time lifetime purchase.
